nodes.name: Recipe Webhook
nodes.notes: Entry point for the Angular app: POST /webhook/code-a-cuisine-recipe with ingredients and preferences. Answers come from the Return nodes.

nodes.name: Validate Request
nodes.notes: Validates ingredients (1-30, name, quantity > 0, unit) and preferences (portions 1-12, cooks 1-3, time, cuisine, diets) and merges duplicates. Runs before the quota, so invalid requests cost nothing.

nodes.name: Route on Validation
nodes.notes: true: valid request, continue with the quota check. false: answer with 400.

nodes.name: Check IP Quota
nodes.notes: Reads the caller IP (IPv4/IPv6) from the proxy headers and enforces 3 generations per IP per day, 12 per day in total and 15 seconds between requests. Counters live in Firebase quota/<date>, workflow static data is the fallback.

nodes.name: Route on Quota
nodes.notes: true: quota left, generate recipes. false: answer with 429.

nodes.name: Return Quota Exceeded
nodes.notes: HTTP 429 with a readable message, the reason code and the current quota.

nodes.name: Prepare Prompt
nodes.notes: Builds the prompt: 70% ingredient usage, max 3 extras, quantities scaled to the portions, cuisine and diet rules, tasks per cook, parallel steps, nutrition and the exact JSON answer format. Adds the rejection reasons on a retry.

messageValues.message: You are an experienced chef and recipe developer. Answer only with one JSON object in the shape given in the prompt, without markdown or comments. Never translate, rename or replace the ingredients of the user. Nutrition values are realistic estimates.

nodes.name: Generate Recipes
nodes.notes: Sends the prompt to the chat model. The Structured Output Parser appends the JSON schema to the prompt and parses the answer, so only the content rules are left for Validate Recipe Result. The error output goes to the error log.

nodes.name: Ollama Cloud Chat Model
nodes.notes: Ollama Cloud (gemma4:31b) through the OpenAI-compatible API in JSON mode. Credential type OpenAI with base URL https://ollama.com/v1.

nodes.name: Structured Output Parser
nodes.notes: Forces the JSON schema: 3 recipes with ingredients, extra ingredients, steps per cook and nutrition. Auto-fix stays off, because its repair call re-prompts the model without the ingredients.

nodes.name: Validate Recipe Result
nodes.notes: Checks the content rules the schema cannot cover: 70% ingredient usage, max 3 extras, tasks for every cook and distinct titles. Adds the per-cook step list and the ingredient coverage, retries once with feedback.

nodes.name: Route on Retry
nodes.notes: true: a rule was broken and an attempt is left, back to Prepare Prompt. false: continue.

nodes.name: Route Recipe Errors
nodes.notes: true: no valid recipes, log and answer with 500. false: return the recipes.

nodes.name: Log Recipe Error
nodes.notes: Writes the failure to the execution log and to Firebase logs/recipeErrors.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { message: $json.recipeErrorMessage ?? 'Recipe generation failed', code: 'RECIPE_GENERATION_FAILED', generatedAt: new Date().toISOString() } }}

={{ { request: { ingredients: $json.ingredients, preferences: $json.preferences }, requesterIp: $json.ipAddress, generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), quota: $json.quota, warnings: $json.recipeWarnings, attempts: $json.attempts, result: $json.recipeResult } }}

nodes.name: Return Recipes
nodes.notes: HTTP 200 with the 3 recipes, the quota and rule warnings.

parameters.content:
## 1. Request and quota
The Angular app posts `{ ingredients: [{ name, quantity, unit }], preferences: { portions, cooks, cookingTime, cuisine, diets }, clientIp, requestedAt }`.

- **Validate Request**: invalid input -> 400 `INVALID_REQUEST`
- **Check IP Quota**: 3 per IP per day, 12 per day in total, 15 s throttle -> 429 `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`, `GLOBAL_QUOTA_EXCEEDED`, `THROTTLED`, `IP_NOT_DETECTED`
- Counters: Firebase `quota/<YYYY-MM-DD>/ips/<ip>` and `quota/<YYYY-MM-DD>/global`

## 2. AI generation
**Prepare Prompt** -> **Generate Recipes** (LLM chain + Structured Output Parser, Ollama Cloud) -> **Validate Recipe Result** (content rules only).

Rule violations (70% ingredients, max 3 extras, every cook has tasks, distinct recipes, 4-12 steps, nutrition) send the recipe back once with feedback (**Route on Retry**).

## 3. Responses, logging and errors
- 200 `{ request, requesterIp, generatedAt, quota, warnings, attempts, result: { recipes } }`
- 500 `RECIPE_GENERATION_FAILED`, logged in Firebase `logs/recipeErrors`
- Unexpected crashes run the **Code-a-Cuisine Error Handler** workflow (email + `logs/workflowErrors`). Set it under Workflow settings -> Error workflow.
